tagline.en: An open video-generation family for both text-to-video and image-to-video, spanning VideoCrafter1 and VideoCrafter2.
tagline.zh: 面向文生视频与图生视频的开源视频生成家族,涵盖 VideoCrafter1 与 VideoCrafter2。

en: VideoCrafter is an open-source family of video-generation models covering both text-to-video and image-to-video. It spans the earlier VideoCrafter1 checkpoints and the newer VideoCrafter2, giving you a few routes depending on the task.

The lineup includes a VideoCrafter1 text-to-video model, a VideoCrafter1 image-to-video model, and VideoCrafter2 for text-to-video. VideoCrafter2 in particular is released under Apache-2.0 with open weights.

In WorldFoundry these run as inference-only routes: pick a checkpoint and set prompt, frame count, fps, and seed, and the shared pipeline renders the clip. Training and dataset tooling are intentionally left out — this is for generation, not fine-tuning.
zh: VideoCrafter 是一个开源视频生成模型家族,涵盖文生视频与图生视频。它跨越了较早的 VideoCrafter1 系列与较新的 VideoCrafter2,让你可以按任务选择不同路径。
阵容包括一个 VideoCrafter1 文生视频模型、一个 VideoCrafter1 图生视频模型,以及用于文生视频的 VideoCrafter2。其中 VideoCrafter2 采用 Apache-2.0 许可,权重开放。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它们以推理路径运行:选一个 checkpoint,设定提示词、帧数、fps 与随机种子,统一 pipeline 便会渲染片段。训练与数据集工具被有意省略——它面向生成,而非微调。

whenToUse.en: A good pick when you want an established open video model and need to choose between text-to-video and image-to-video. Reach for VideoCrafter2 when you want the openly-licensed text-to-video route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个成熟的开源视频模型,并需要在文生视频与图生视频之间选择时,它是不错的选择。若想走开放许可的文生视频路径,选 VideoCrafter2。

notFor.en: Not for training or fine-tuning here — only inference is packaged. Licensing on the older VideoCrafter1 checkpoints isn't stated, so check terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 此处不适合训练或微调——仅打包了推理。较旧的 VideoCrafter1 checkpoint 未标明许可,商用前请先确认条款。
